entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Cut label

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Look, [fName]. That creature has[n]such an unusual form... It's[n]fascinating, is it not?
It's pretty bizarre.
You think so?
Truly one of life's mysteries.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So you agree. Hmm... The longer I[n]observe it, the more intriguing it[n]becomes.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes. Those fins, those gills... It's unlike[n]anything mere humans can relate to.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I couldn't have said it better myself![n]Perhaps I'll try sketching that fish[n]sometime soon.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ahh... This sort of experience always[n]leads me to new discoveries.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: By the way...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It may be the fish we're looking at,[n]but I'm feeling a bit hungry.
They're not for sale!
Same here.
Want a free sample?[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hmph... Is that how you see me,[n][fName]? I'm not that uncivilized.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...But I must say, that giant crab looks[n]delicious.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Then why don't we get sushi after this?[n]I can subsist on your side of ginger.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Heh... I admire creative solutions,[n]but this may not be the best time.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Well then, let's continue onward. I wish[n]to attend the sea lion show.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I spent the last of my savings on the[n]entrance fee, so let's walk home today.
